title: Rafa en Ruinas
style: Drift phonk / slowed mansion-club with half-time intro, then double-time verse drive; verses ride sparse kick, sub, and chopped cowbell, pre-chorus strips to hiss and whisper, chorus opens with distorted hook stacks and emotional melodic lift. Male whisper lead with female ethereal echoes, trilingual ad-libs in English Spanish French, tape-worn texture, sharp low-end glide, viral heartbreak replay energy, punchy and gritty mix, latin, emotional, lo-fi
lyrics:
[Intro]
Rafa...
me dejaste en el loop
j’entends ton nom
in the smoke

[Verse 1]
Black coat on the rail
same scar on my tongue
I said “stay”
you said “run”
Tu me veux? no sé
you went cold so fast
Ahora piso sombras
and I don’t look back

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold me close, then break it slow
déjà vu in a motel glow
Dímelo, baby
one more lie
I can taste your goodbye

[Chorus]
Rafa, Rafa
my heart won’t fold
Rafa, Rafa
you took my gold
Dímelo, baby
stay in my head
Rafa, Rafa
I’m not dead yet
Rafa, Rafa
my heart won’t fold
Rafa, Rafa
you took my gold
Je t’entends encore
in the red line glow
Rafa, Rafa
don’t let go

[Verse 2]
Late-night texts on read
I scroll through the ache
Your name hit hard
like a glass that breaks
Sigo en la calle
but I’m nowhere near
Même si tu pars
I still hear you here
My hands on the wheel
heart on ice
One more turn
and I pay that price

[Pre-Chorus]
Hold me close, then break it slow
déjà vu in a motel glow
Dímelo, baby
one more lie
I can taste your goodbye

[Chorus]
Rafa, Rafa
my heart won’t fold
Rafa, Rafa
you took my gold
Dímelo, baby
stay in my head
Rafa, Rafa
I’m not dead yet
Rafa, Rafa
my heart won’t fold
Rafa, Rafa
you took my gold
Je t’entends encore
in the red line glow
Rafa, Rafa
don’t let go

[Bridge]
Bajo la luna
I’m split in three
toi, moi, and the bruise in me
If I disappear
say my name right
Rafa in the dark
till the morning light

[Final Chorus]
Rafa, Rafa
my heart won’t fold
Rafa, Rafa
you took my gold
Dímelo, baby
stay in my head
Rafa, Rafa
I’m not dead yet
Rafa, Rafa
my heart won’t fold
Rafa, Rafa
you took my gold
Je t’entends encore
in the red line glow
Rafa, Rafa
don’t let go
